summary.text: CONSEPT VERDAL AS is a private limited company registered in Verdal, founded 2012-11-05. CONSEPT VERDAL AS trades in clothing, and engages in all activities naturally connected with this, as well as participating in or owning other companies. Its main industry code is 47.710: retail sale of clothing. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 4 112 784 NOK and the annual result was -133 385 NOK; operating income was down from 4 215 981 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from -93 109 NOK in 2024 to -133 385 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Morten Skaufel (daglig leder and styrets leder). The registered employee count went from 6 on 2025-11-13 to 10 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-23 (erIKonsern).
